page.overview:
Who is Dwin Arnae?

Dwin Arnae was a male Human captain in the Imperial Customs in the Minos Cluster. He was known for being a perfectionist. His goal was to apprehend and prosecute every customs violation, no matter how small the infraction was.

He had joined the Imperial Navy at an early age, but only rose to the rank of Staff Sergeant. After reporting some minor infractions of his superiors over their heads, he was removed from his post and transferred to the Sector Interdiction Office. He captained an Imperial Customs corvette.

Dwin Arane was a small, mousy, wiry man who was far more dedicated to his job in Imperial Customs then almost anyone else. His personal goal was to apprehend and prosecute the most customs violators. Although dedicated to his job in the Minos Cluster, his perfectionist attitude caused his crew to hate him to the point of overlooking infractions they discovered on ships just to hamper him. For this reason, many free-traders of the Cluster were almost relieved when they discovered it was Dwin who would've conducted the search of their ship.

Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters, Second Edition
